what.text: This page follows refugees from Poland living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 182 Polish refugees in Sweden, 13.3% of all refugees from Poland.
Germany hosts the most Polish refugees, followed by Canada, Denmark and Sweden.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Poland, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1992.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at its highest figure, 6091 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
